a1_input.evidence: The FSE workbooks omit the target revision. The four records are dependency-update experiments against modules of one root repository, not four historical target commits.

target_history.evidence: All 545 commits reachable from every remote ref were inspected. Across 134 unique POM blobs, all 26 blobs declaring antlr-runtime use 3.2 and none uses 3.3. The repository never adopted the failing input and has no later maintainer response under ANTLR Runtime 3.3.

replay.reason: Strict admission requires a fixed historical A1 input and an exact maintainer A2. Neither exists; changing the POM to 3.3 and inventing a parser repair would only reproduce the external experiment and create a synthetic recovery.
